title: Qantas to outsource 850 Australian IT jobs
excerpt: Australian airline Qantas plans to outsource 850 local roles, with the majority moving to India as part of an IT modernization effort.
body_html:
Australian airline Qantas has announced plans to outsource 850 local jobs, with the majority of these roles shifting to India. The company stated that the decision is designed to help modernise its information technology systems.

In its announcement, the airline also pointed to the impact of artificial intelligence as a factor in the transition. The restructuring affects local positions within the company as it looks to update its technological infrastructure.
